messages:
Priya N: kicking off packaging for private-vpc/onprem v1.4.3-rc4 — aiming for Tue 22:00 UTC canary window. need image pins, cosign sigs, airgap bundle, and release-notes draft. @oncall please reserve the 22:00-00:00 UTC change window.
Alex M: sgtm. Ill handle the image pins and push manifests. any blockers for cosign?
Ryan O: uploading a build artifact now. tagging as v1.4.3-rc4. will post checksums once upload finishes.
Deploy-bot: artifact uploaded to s3://redwood-airgap/private/v1.4.3-rc4.tar.gz (size 1.2GB) — build-id: build-3821
Alex M: pinned image manifest: registry.redwood.net/private-installer@sha256:3f4b9a7c2d6e8a4b37f9a2c9f1b2c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1
Alex M: image tag: private-installer:v1.4.3-rc4
Ryan O: checksum (sha256): 3f4b9a7c2d6e8a4b37f9a2c9f1b2c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1
Ryan O: cosign signing now, will push signature and attestations.
Emily L: quick checklist: 1) cosign sig present 2) cosign public key uploaded to KMS 3) installer smoke tests green 4) release notes published 5) oncall aware for canary
Carlos G: smoke tests running on lab cluster (kube-lab-3). I'll post results in ~15m.
Nina R: release-notes PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pulls/78 — draft includes breaking changes for private installer config and new KMS guidance. please review.
Ryan O: cosign sig pushed. signature: cosign.sig (base64) — attestations added (SBOM + provenance).
Ops-bot: cosign verification: OK for registry.redwood.net/private-installer@sha256:3f4b9a7c... verified with key: projects/redwood/kms/cosign-pub
Priya N: excellent. decision point: proceed with staged canary at 22:00 UTC, 5% traffic to dedicated canary pool, monitor for 60m, rollback criteria: >5% 5xx or latency p50 increase >200ms. agree?
Alex M: agree to rollback metrics. also pin a fallback image (v1.4.2-stable) in the routing policy in case we need instant fallback.
Emily L: +1. add auto-fallback to stable after 3 consecutive failed health checks.
Carlos G: smoke tests: all green except an intermittent cert warning in edge case (internal ticket created: INF-2137). not fatal for canary but callout in notes.
Priya N: ok include INF-2137 in release notes under Known Issues.
Nina R: updated RN PR with Known Issues and rollback steps + cosign verification commands.
Alex M: pushing final manifest to production registry and updating pinning config:
```
# pinning manifest snippet
- name: private-installer
  reference: registry.redwood.net/private-installer@sha256:3f4b9a7c2d6e8a4b37f9a2c9f1b2c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1
  fallback: registry.redwood.net/private-installer:v1.4.2-stable
```
Alex M: also cosign verify command for ops: `cosign verify --key cosign.pub registry.redwood.net/private-installer@sha256:3f4b9a7c...`
Deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for Tue 22:00 UTC -> canary-pool-private (5% traffic)
Priya N: final sign-off checklist: cosign ok, smoke tests ok, RN PR merged, change window reserved. can anyone raise objections now?
Emily L: no objections from security side, cosign key checks look good.
Carlos G: no objections from infra — canary monitoring dashboards ready (tokens, p50/p95, 5xx).
Nina R: RN PR merged.
Alex M: rolling pins + tags pushed. all set from my side.
Priya N: thanks — we'll monitor closely. if anything trips the rollback criteria we will revert routing pins and redeploy fallback image. call for rollback will be: Priya N, Alex M, and Oncall.
Ryan O: noted, will keep an eye on cosign attestation logs too.
Deploy-bot: canary rollout started at 1823457600 (Tue 22:00 UTC).
Ops-bot: monitoring alerts configured: canary-health, latency-regression, 5xx-spike. thresholds match playbook.
Emily L: if we see p50 > baseline +200ms for 2 consecutive 1m windows, we trigger rollback.
Carlos G: first 30m: no errors, p50 steady. reporting every 5m.
Priya N: 45m into canary: one spike in 5xx (0.4% of canary requests) — under threshold. continuing.
Alex M: 58m: p50 +220ms for 1 window only, p95 OK. still borderline. holding decision for next 2m.
Priya N: at 61m p50 back to baseline. no rollback. holding for full 60m after spike per playbook.
Nina R: merging final release-notes to main and tagging release v1.4.3
Ryan O: canary complete at 120m with no sustained regressions. promoting to full rollout in next 30m.
Deploy-bot: full rollout scheduled and executed — all clusters receiving private-installer:v1.4.3-rc4 -> promoted to v1.4.3 at registry.
Priya N: shipped. logs and post-release checklist in the /releases/1.4.3 folder. thanks everyone for quick turn. :tada: 
Alex M: created follow-up ticket to address INF-2137 with priority P2.
Emily L: adding retrospective notes and monitoring runbook updates.
Priya N: closing thread. if any late regressions ping #incidents. good job team. :rocket:
